name: World clocks
description: Two to eight live clocks for the cities you work with — analog, digital or both, with the date, a day/night cue and the hour difference from this screen. Lays itself out as a grid, a portrait list or a thin strip. Nothing is fetched: the times come from the screen's own clock.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: title
params.label: Title
params.help: Leave empty to hide the title bar.

params.name: clocks
params.label: Clocks
params.help: One clock per line, as City | IANA timezone — for example Mumbai | Asia/Kolkata. 2 to 8 lines; lines with an unknown timezone are skipped and listed at the bottom of the screen.
params.default:
London | Europe/London
New York | America/New_York
Tokyo | Asia/Tokyo
Sydney | Australia/Sydney
Dubai | Asia/Dubai
San Francisco | America/Los_Angeles

params.name: show_daynight
params.label: Show day and night
params.help: Daytime clocks get a light face and a sun; night-time clocks a dark face and a moon.

params.name: highlight_local
params.label: Highlight this screen's city
params.help: Outlines the clock whose timezone matches the screen's own (or the one set below).

params.name: home_timezone
params.label: This screen's timezone
params.help: Used for the highlight and the +/- hours. Leave empty to use the screen's own setting.

params.name: locale
params.label: Date language
params.help: For example en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP. Leave empty for the screen's language.
